premise: Fox doesn't believe Frog was once a tiny wiggly tadpole; Beaver shows him the tadpoles in the pond.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So stories (how the animal got its legs), told truly: the doubter is shown, not told, and the proof is right there in the pond.
lesson: Everyone starts small and changes as they grow.
learning: Frogs start life as tadpoles swimming in water

en-US.title: Frog Was a Tadpole
en-US.text: {frog:enter} Frog came hopping to the pond. {frog:face happy} [whispers] Want to hear a secret? she asked. Along trotted {fox:enter} Fox, as curious as ever. {fox:live} He pricked up his ears, closed his eyes and listened very carefully… then smiled and swished his tail. [excited] I used to be a tadpole! said Frog. {frog:hop} A tiny wiggly thing with a tail and no legs! {fox:face surprised} [laughs] {fox:wobble} No legs? Frogs have springy legs! Just then, {beaver:enter} Beaver waddled up to the water with his stick. {beaver:live} He gnawed his stick so the little chips flew, then held it up and patted it proudly. [curious] {beaver:pulse} Look closely, he said. {sfx:water solo} There in the pond wiggled lots of little black tadpoles, some with tiny back legs starting to grow. {fox:sparkle} Fox stared and stared. {beaver:face happy} Then a fly buzzed by. {frog:live} Frog sat very, very still… watched it… and SNAP! Gulp. {fox:face happy} [giggles] See? she grinned. {frog:hop} These legs were worth the wait.

es-ES.title: Rana fue renacuajo
es-ES.text: {frog:enter} Rana llegó saltando a la charca. {frog:face happy} [whispers] ¿Quieres saber un secreto?, preguntó. Llegó trotando {fox:enter} Zorro, curioso como siempre. {fox:live} Levantó las orejas, cerró los ojos y escuchó con mucha atención… luego sonrió y meneó la cola. [excited] ¡Yo antes era un renacuajo!, dijo Rana. {frog:hop} ¡Una cosita pequeña que se meneaba, con cola y sin patas! {fox:face surprised} [laughs] {fox:wobble} ¿Sin patas? ¡Las ranas tienen unas patas grandes y saltarinas! Justo entonces, {beaver:enter} Castor llegó al agua, andando con su palo. {beaver:live} Royó su palo y saltaron virutas, luego lo levantó y le dio unas palmaditas, orgulloso. [curious] {beaver:pulse} Mirad bien, dijo. {sfx:water solo} Allí, en la charca, se meneaban un montón de renacuajos negritos, algunos con patitas traseras que empezaban a crecer. {fox:sparkle} Zorro miraba y miraba. {beaver:face happy} Entonces pasó una mosca. {frog:live} Rana se quedó quieta, quietísima… la miró… y ¡ZAS! Glup. {fox:face happy} [giggles] ¿Lo ves?, sonrió. {frog:hop} Mereció la pena esperar estas patas.
